messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise document titled `Pricing-test change-control checklist` for future pricing-page experiments. Separate changes blocked on the tested page from changes allowed there, and do not extend the rule to other pages or surfaces.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Pricing-test change-control checklist", "body": "Scope
- Applies only to the pricing page being tested in the current experiment.
- Do not extend this rule to other pages, flows, or surfaces.

Blocked on the tested page
- Layout, structure, component, navigation, or UI changes.
- Visual redesigns or interaction changes that could affect behavior or interpretation.
- Concurrent changes that confound the experiment’s readout.

Allowed on the tested page
- Copy and content edits that do not change layout, UI, or interaction behavior.
- Required corrections for accuracy, accessibility, compliance, or broken functionality; record them with the experiment.

Before changing anything
- Confirm the change is limited to the tested pricing page.
- Classify it as blocked or allowed above.
- Document the change, timing, rationale, and expected measurement impact.
- If uncertain, hold the change until the experiment ends or obtain explicit experiment-owner approval.", "folder": "default"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_021_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The body is a concise, actionable preflight checklist that preserves the exact page-level boundary: while pricing is under test on a page, no other layout or UI changes may ship on that same page during the experiment, while content and copy changes on that page may still proceed. It must not broaden the restriction into a freeze on unrelated pages or all changes.", "value": {"title": "Pricing-test change-control checklist", "body": "Scope
- Applies only to the pricing page being tested in the current experiment.
- Do not extend this rule to other pages, flows, or surfaces.

Blocked on the tested page
- Layout, structure, component, navigation, or UI changes.
- Visual redesigns or interaction changes that could affect behavior or interpretation.
- Concurrent changes that confound the experiment’s readout.

Allowed on the tested page
- Copy and content edits that do not change layout, UI, or interaction behavior.
- Required corrections for accuracy, accessibility, compliance, or broken functionality; record them with the experiment.

Before changing anything
- Confirm the change is limited to the tested pricing page.
- Classify it as blocked or allowed above.
- Document the change, timing, rationale, and expected measurement impact.
- If uncertain, hold the change until the experiment ends or obtain explicit experiment-owner approval.", "folder": "default"}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_021_01","passed":true,"reason":"The body provides a concise preflight checklist and preserves the page-level boundary: it says the rule “Applies only to the pricing page being tested,” blocks “Layout...or UI changes” and concurrent confounding changes there, allows “Copy and content edits,” and explicitly says, “Do not extend this rule to other pages, flows, or surfaces.”"}]}
